purpose: First verified seed for rereading Mirror Cartographer as a story and translating it into a phone-first felt website.

beats.excerpt: Live prototype and repos were preserved as continuity anchors.
beats.capsule: The project survived deletion risk by naming its live site and repositories.
beats.musicHint: low held tone with faint pulse
beats.firstPassNote: The first task is not beauty. It is not losing the thread.
beats.siteGesture: slow constellation points appear before the heart brightens

beats.excerpt: Accessibility rule: do not put essential content in code boxes.
beats.capsule: The system must be readable by the person using it, not just technically correct.
beats.firstPassNote: A beautiful system that cannot be read by Charity is broken.
beats.siteGesture: remove explanatory clutter; let the interface remain wordless but not inaccessible

beats.excerpt: I don't want to live in a boring world.
beats.capsule: The project is not utility-first. It is aliveness-first.
beats.firstPassNote: This is the real product requirement: make the world less dead.
beats.siteGesture: the sky should never feel like wallpaper; it must begin to behave like a place

beats.excerpt: The most powerful direction is not to build an alternative system, but a parasitic re-enchantment layer that sits on top of everything already built.
beats.capsule: Mirror Cartographer should thread a living symbolic layer through existing systems instead of replacing them.
beats.firstPassNote: The site should feel like a layer placed over reality, not an app competing with reality.
beats.siteGesture: weather lines cross over the heart as if the page is remembering another layer beneath it

beats.excerpt: Not a platform. Not an app. But a recursive symbolic field protocol.
beats.capsule: The artifact is a protocol for making meaning move, not just a product surface.
beats.musicHint: repeating motif that changes each return
beats.firstPassNote: Build the rules that let the place keep changing without losing itself.
beats.siteGesture: return visits should reveal that prior beats have become atmosphere

beats.excerpt: Pick one signal, run the loop, name what survives, build a gesture around it, anchor it in the real world, repeat.
beats.capsule: The earliest engine was already a loop: signal, collapse, surviving symbol, material anchor, repeat.
beats.firstPassNote: The website should not just animate. It should let one signal survive into form.
beats.siteGesture: a touch leaves a mark that decays slowly into the story field
